stow_dir.description: Root directory containing separate packages in private subtrees.

target_dir.description: Root of the tree in which packages appear to be installed.

verbose_level.description: Verbosity level from 0 (default) to 5. 0 is quiet, higher levels provide more output.

dotfiles.description: Enable special handling for dotfiles by replacing 'dot-' prefix with '.' in package names.

ignore_patterns.description: List of Perl regular expressions for files to ignore during stow operations. Command line and resource file options are appended together.

defer_patterns.description: List of Perl regular expressions for files that should not be stowed if already stowed to another package.

override_patterns.description: List of Perl regular expressions for files that should be forcibly stowed even if already stowed to another package.

packages.description: List of package names to stow. Note: Per stow(8), packages listed in the resource file are ignored; this is included for schema completeness regarding command-line usage.
